cases.uq: Retrieve target ChEMBL_ID, target_name, target_type, protein accessions and sequences for all protein targets:
cases.generated_sql: SELECT td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.target_type, cs.accession, cs.sequence FROM target_dictionary td JOIN target_type tt ON td.target_type = tt.target_type JOIN target_components tc ON td.tid = tc.tid JOIN component_sequences cs ON tc.component_id = cs.component_id WHERE tt.parent_type = 'PROTEIN';
cases.judge_text: {"analysis": "The query correctly retrieves all five requested columns (target_chembl_id, target_name, target_type, accession, sequence) for all protein targets by filtering on target_type.parent_type = 'PROTEIN', which covers SINGLE PROTEIN, PROTEIN COMPLEX, PROTEIN COMPLEX GROUP, PROTEIN FAMILY, PROTEIN-PROTEIN INTERACTION, SELECTIVITY GROUP, CHIMERIC PROTEIN, and PROTEIN NUCLEIC-ACID COMPLEX. The join through target_components to component_sequences properly retrieves protein accessions and sequences for each target's components. No LIMIT clause is used, so all rows are returned. The sample shows diverse target types and valid accessions/sequences. The result is truthful and complete.", "score": 1.0, "decision": "YES"}
